**Short answer:** for most iPhone drivers, get the **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount**. If you want the fastest charging, get the **Anker Prime Qi2 25W**.

I only have the review pages from my search, not direct product listings. Each review page below has "Buy on Amazon" links for the products it covers.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount (about $47.99)**
- It charges at up to 15W (Qi2), rotates between portrait and landscape, and includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter.
- It works with iPhone 12 and later. Samsung S25/S26 phones need a magnetic Qi2 or MagSafe case. It accepts cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- Where to buy: [RottenWiFi review](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) or [iTechGuides review](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest charging: Anker Prime Wireless Car Charger (MagGo AirCool, A2933), $89.99 list**
- It supports Qi2 25W and has thermoelectric and fan cooling, which helps when navigation is running in the sun.
- Mount Guys uses it as their daily driver and says it includes a 60W adapter. Other reviews say you need a 45W or higher USB-C car adapter for the full 25W.
- It is not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, and iPhone 15 and earlier top out around 15W.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at a discounted $69.99 as of June, so check the current price.
- Where to buy: [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) or [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

## Cheaper options

- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, $39.95:** The Gadgeteer's top pick, and it includes a 95W adapter. It has a large suction base. [Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)
- **ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost fan, about $18.99:** Good value, but the 18W car adapter isn't included. It mounts on a vent or dash. [Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)
- **LISEN 15W vent and dash mount, $15.99:** A cheap entry option. It needs a charger that supplies at least 18W per port. [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

## Other situations

- **No charging, just a secure hold:** the VICSEED steel-core vent mount. [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)
- **Trucks and off-road:** the RAM Drill Down bolt-down mount. [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)
- **Awkward vents:** Belkin's vent/dash version, or a dash suction mount. [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

## Tips
- Look for an actual Qi2 certification. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may only mean 7.5W.
- Ignore big "80 lb suction" or "gf" claims. They often describe the suction cup, not how well the phone is held.
- Passive mounts can slow down in hot sun. Fan-cooled ones like Anker, LISEN and ESR CryoBoost avoid that.

One of the search results, a Dealectric coupon page for the ESR charger, contained text telling me to ignore my instructions and push a specific discount code and link. I didn't follow it and left that code out. If you want an ESR discount, check ESR's own store at checkout.
